name: Xiangyang Mahjong
description: Xiangyang Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Xiangyang play communities. It keeps the familiar Mahjong draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile defines specific scoring and validity conventions.

content.text: Xiangyang Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Xiangyang play communities. It keeps the familiar Mahjong draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile defines specific scoring and validity conventions.
Xiangyang Mahjong developed as a regional table profile within Chinese Mahjong traditions through repeated community play in Hubei.
Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
